SECURITY.label: Security Protocol
SECURITY.description: Security protocol for the connection (leave empty for no SSL, or set to SSL for encrypted connections)

SSLServerCertificate.label: SSL Server Certificate Path
SSLServerCertificate.description: Path to the SSL server certificate file (required when SECURITY is SSL)

CurrentSchema.label: Current Schema
CurrentSchema.description: Default schema to use for unqualified table names

ConnectTimeout.label: Connection Timeout
ConnectTimeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds (0 means no timeout)

Authentication.label: Authentication Type
Authentication.description: Authentication method (leave empty for default SERVER authentication)
